column1: # Parity cases that stop on a typed refusal on the Rust arm although the Rust engine serves the member. One file per owner; the columns are those of the other pin files.

column2: a labelled-only member's remote forget-tier read answers its own member page fact and nothing else on PGLite and Postgres, and the Rust store stops (row 32e-b-5)
column6: A labelled-only member's remote fact floor for a forget (storeRemoteFloor): the floor renders the plain provenance fragment ANDed with the labelled-only fact conjunct, which the store has no form for, so the read refuses (fail closed) for every labelled-only caller with lineage off or on

column2: a labelled-only member's single-fact lookup under the remote floor (storeFloorPolicy) finds the fact on its own member page only on PGLite and Postgres, and the Rust store stops (row 32e-b-5)
column6: A labelled-only member's remote fact floor for a single-fact lookup (storeFloorPolicy): the same floor text, which the store has no form for, so the lookup refuses (fail closed) for every labelled-only caller with lineage off or on

column2: a labelled-only audience of two identities reads the facts both may read on PGLite and Postgres, and the Rust store stops (row 32e-b-5)
column6: A labelled-only member whose record holds an audience of several identities (accessAllowedForAllSql: one test per identity): callerReference cannot render it for the store, so the fact read refuses (fail closed) with lineage off or on

column2: as_of reads an edition a labelled-only member may read on PGLite and Postgres, and the Rust store stops on pickValidTimeEdition (row 32e-b-5)
column6: An as_of edition read for a labelled-only member: the snapshot policy of an edition (callerReadersAllowedSql 'snapshot' ANDed with the labelled-only conjunct on the live page) is not the canonical one the store models, so the pick refuses (fail closed)
